name: Chat Quote for WooCommerce – Instant Chat & Order Quote Widget
author: prokashsarker2026

sections.description:
Chat Quote for WooCommerce is the ultimate lightweight communication plugin designed to skyrocket your conversion rates. It seamlessly integrates a powerful on-site live chat and a direct-to-WhatsApp messaging system into your WooCommerce store, making it easier than ever for customers to request quotes, ask pre-sale questions, and finalize orders via WhatsApp.

With our plugin, when a customer sends a message from a product page, the product name, price, SKU, and link are automatically attached to their message. You will know exactly what they want to buy the second they message you!

🚀 Why choose Chat Quote for WooCommerce?

  • Order on WhatsApp: Add a beautiful “Order on WhatsApp” or “Get a Quote” button right below your Add to Cart button.
  • Automatic Product Context: When a user clicks the WhatsApp button on a product page, the plugin automatically drafts a message containing the Product Name, Price, SKU, and URL. No more asking “Which product are you talking about?”!
  • Built-in Live Chat Widget: Engage customers with a fast, AJAX-powered floating chat widget. Messages are stored in your WordPress database so you never miss a lead.
  • Full Cart Support: Customers can share their entire WooCommerce cart via WhatsApp in a single click — including every product, price, quantity, and SKU.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track button clicks, view top-performing products, monitor 7-day click trends, and keep an eye on pending messages — all from a dedicated analytics screen inside your WordPress admin.
  • Fully Customizable Buttons: Change button colors, text, border radius, hover effects, and even upload custom icons for product, shop, floating, and cart buttons.
  • Flexible Button Placement: Choose to display the WhatsApp button before the Add to Cart button, after it, or in the product meta area.
  • WhatsApp Fallback Number: Set a primary and a fallback WhatsApp number so messages always reach your team.
  • Auto-Redirect to WhatsApp: Optionally redirect customers straight to WhatsApp after they submit a chat message on your website.
  • Customizable Message Template: Personalize the default WhatsApp message using variables like {product_name}, {product_price}, {product_sku}, {product_qty}, and {product_url}.
  • Mobile-Friendly Design: The chat widget and all buttons are fully responsive and look great on every screen size.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Zero bloat — only loads assets on pages where they are needed.
  • 🌍 Translation Ready (10 Languages): Fully translated into Bengali, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, and Chinese.
  • WordPress Playground Ready: Test the plugin instantly with our Live Preview blueprint. No installation required.

🔧 Where do buttons appear?

  • ✅ Single Product Pages — “Chat on WhatsApp” button
  • ✅ Shop / Archive Pages — “Request Quote” button on each product card
  • ✅ Cart Page — “Send Cart to WhatsApp” button after cart totals
  • ✅ All Pages — Floating chat button (bottom-right corner)

💬 On-Site Chat Widget

The floating chat widget provides a professional live chat experience right on your store:

  • Customers enter their name, phone number, and message
  • Product details are auto-attached when chatting from a product page
  • After sending, customers can choose to continue on website chat or switch to WhatsApp
  • All messages are saved with status tracking: Pending → Read → Replied

📊 Admin Dashboard Features

  • Chat Messages — View, search, and manage all customer inquiries with status tracking
  • Analytics — Total clicks, top 10 products by engagement, 7-day click trends
  • WP Dashboard Widget — Quick snapshot of click stats and unread messages right on your WordPress dashboard
  • Settings Panel — Full control over WhatsApp numbers, button styles, chat widget behavior, and message templates

🔌 Plugin Compatibility

  • Works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme
  • Compatible with WordPress Multisite
  • Clean uninstall — removes all settings and data on deletion
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Search for “Chat Quote for WooCommerce” and click Install Now.
  3. Click Activate to enable the plugin.
  4. Navigate to Chat Quote → Settings in the admin sidebar.
  5. Enter your WhatsApp phone number (with country code, e.g., +1234567890).
  6. Toggle the buttons and chat widget on or off for product, shop, cart, and floating positions.
  7. Customize button colors, icons, and message templates to match your brand.
  8. Save your settings — you’re all set!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and configure settings under Chat Quote → Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active. The plugin will display a friendly admin notice if WooCommerce is not detected.

What WhatsApp number format should I use?

Use the full international number format without any spaces, dashes, or plus signs. For example: 1234567890 for a US number. The plugin strips non-digit characters automatically.

Can I use this plugin without WhatsApp?

Yes! The on-site live chat widget works independently. You can disable WhatsApp buttons and use only the website chat feature to receive messages directly in your WordPress admin.

Does it support WhatsApp?

Absolutely. WhatsApp is a core feature. The plugin creates deep links using wa.me that open WhatsApp on both desktop and mobile devices.

Will the WhatsApp message include product details?

Yes. When a customer clicks the WhatsApp button from a product or cart page, the message automatically includes the product name, price, SKU, quantity, and URL.

Can I customize the WhatsApp message?

Yes. Go to Chat Quote → Settings and edit the Default Message Template. You can use these variables: {product_name}, {product_price}, {product_sku}, {product_qty}, {product_url}.

Where are chat messages stored?

Messages are stored securely in a custom database table (wp_tqfw_chat_messages) within your WordPress database. You can view and manage them from Chat Quote → Chat Messages in the admin panel.

Are messages stored?

Yes, messages are stored in a custom database table with full CRUD support. You can view, search, mark as read/replied, and delete messages.

Can I customize button colors and icons?

Yes. The settings panel lets you change the button background color, text color, border color, hover color, border radius, and upload custom icons for product, shop, floating, and cart buttons.

Is it performance friendly?

Very much so. The plugin only loads CSS and JavaScript on pages where buttons or the chat widget are actually active. It uses efficient AJAX calls and object caching for database queries.

Does the plugin work on mobile?

Yes. The chat widget and all buttons are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.

Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme.

Does it support WordPress Multisite?

Yes. The plugin includes full multisite support including per-site settings and clean uninstall across all network sites.

Is there a live demo?

Yes! Click the Live Preview button on the plugin page to test it instantly using WordPress Playground — no installation needed.
